Cookie Policy

Last updated: 25 October 2026

Cookies and browser storage

Cookies and similar technologies store or access information on your device. This website uses local storage to remember cookie choices; local storage is not sent automatically with each request like a cookie.

Remembering your choice

The key dd-cookie-consent-v3 stores whether you allowed optional content and the date your choice was saved. It does not contain your enquiry, review or chat messages. This preference is used to apply your choices and remains in that browser until changed or cleared. Version 3 asks for a fresh choice because Trustpilot has been added as an optional provider. Browsing in a different browser or clearing site data may cause the banner to appear again.

Optional PeoplePerHour and Trustpilot content

The Reviews page includes an optional PeoplePerHour profile widget. The homepage and Reviews page also include an optional Trustpilot Review Collector widget. Neither provider is loaded until you allow optional third-party content. Loading a widget connects your browser to that provider, which can receive your IP address and request information and may use its own storage. Rejecting optional content does not prevent you reading the reviews or following an ordinary link to either provider’s profile. You can withdraw permission through Cookie Settings. Withdrawing permission removes the widgets. Existing third-party cookies can also be cleared in your browser.

Other website services

Enquiry submission and review moderation use Cloudflare and Resend as described in the Privacy Policy. Burt sends a question and recent conversation context when you ask it a question. Cal.com opens as a separate booking site when you follow a booking link. Fonts are requested from Google Fonts. Cloudflare security or authentication functions may use necessary technologies when those functions are used. The website source does not include Google Analytics or Meta advertising pixels; this is not a claim about every technology an external service may use on its own website.

Changing your choice

Use to allow or reject optional third-party content. You can also clear site storage or manage cookies through your browser. Rejecting optional content leaves essential site functions available. Changing consent does not undo data already received by an external service.
